analysis.purpose: Motion-segment/sphere contact-normal query with an endpoint-inside requirement. It normalizes b-a, computes the intersection discriminant, rejects a negative discriminant or endpoint distance exceeding the radius, and writes (a + dir*(dot-sqrt(disc)) - c)/r. The broader collision contract and original API names remain uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: a0/a1/a2 are three-component float-vector pointers. a3 carries radius float bits, transferred to f20. The output-vector pointer is the fifth argument at entry sp+0x10. Returns integer 0 or 1 in v0. Vector components occupy +0/+4/+8.

calls.observed_abi: a0 points to the mutable direction vector. The callee returns integer normalization status; this caller ignores it.
Squared endpoint distance enters in f12; float result returns in f0 and is compared with the radius.
